related.title: DeepLab：空洞卷積與取樣盲點
related.titleEn: DeepLab: atrous convolution and sampling gaps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付粗細網格、標籤縮放測試與細線召回表。；64與256位置表吻合，標籤處理保持離散類別，評分排除padding。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver coarse/fine grids, label-resizing tests and thin-line recall.; Position counts match, labels stay discrete and scoring excludes padding.
related.difference: 畫5×5及9×9方格，只標實際9個取樣點，旁列未取樣位置。；跨度5與9可重建，且報告明列9點取樣與未取樣區。
related.differenceEn: Draw5×5 and9×9 grids marking only the nine sampled points and the gaps.; Reconstruct spans5 and9 and explicitly identify sampled points and gaps.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 輸出步幅S對應(H/S)(W/S)個粗網格位置；上採樣恢復尺寸但不自動恢復細節。；教學輸入256×256，比較S32與S16，整除且無邊界取整。；N=(256/32)²=64；S16時N=256。
有效核跨度keff=1+(k−1)d；跨度增加不代表每個中間位置被取樣。；教學k3、d2，改為d4；權重仍9個每輸入輸出通道對。；keff=1+2×2=5 px；d4時9 px。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Output stride S yields(H/S)(W/S) coarse positions; upsampling restores size but not automatically detail.; Teaching input256×256, S32 versus S16, exactly divisible.; N=(256/32)²=64; S16 gives256.
Effective span keff=1+(k−1)d; wider span does not sample every intermediate position.; Teaching k3,d2 then d4; still nine weights per channel pair.; keff=1+2×2=5 px; d4 gives9 px.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: BERT：遮罩語言目標與資料洩漏
related.titleEn: BERT: masked-language targets and leakage checks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付粗細網格、標籤縮放測試與細線召回表。；64與256位置表吻合，標籤處理保持離散類別，評分排除padding。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver coarse/fine grids, label-resizing tests and thin-line recall.; Position counts match, labels stay discrete and scoring excludes padding.
related.difference: 列input IDs、有效遮罩、被選目標及原始labels四欄；把替換策略與選取機率分開。；期望30與40正確，非目標labels擾動不影響loss且padding無貢獻。
related.differenceEn: List input IDs, valid masks, target selection and original labels; separate replacement policy from selection probability.; Expectations30 and40 match; nontarget labels and padding do not affect loss.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 輸出步幅S對應(H/S)(W/S)個粗網格位置；上採樣恢復尺寸但不自動恢復細節。；教學輸入256×256，比較S32與S16，整除且無邊界取整。；N=(256/32)²=64；S16時N=256。
若每個有效token以機率p選為預測目標，期望目標數E=Np；實際樣本數受抽樣策略影響。；教學有效token200，p=.15；改p=.2，padding不計入。；E=200×.15=30；p.2時40。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Output stride S yields(H/S)(W/S) coarse positions; upsampling restores size but not automatically detail.; Teaching input256×256, S32 versus S16, exactly divisible.; N=(256/32)²=64; S16 gives256.
With target-selection probability p, expected targets E=Np; realized counts depend on sampling policy.; Teaching200 valid tokens,p=.15 then.2; exclude padding.; E=200×.15=30; p.2 gives40.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
